title: Configuração de Redes Virtuais e Subnets para Container Apps no Azure
rawContent:
You have an Azure subscription that contains the virtual networks shown in the following table.

| Name   | Location | IP address space | Subnet               |
|--------|----------|------------------|----------------------|
| VNet1  | East US  | 10.1.128.0/23    | Subnet1              |
| VNet2  | East US  | 192.168.0.0/16   | Subnet21, Subnet23   |
| VNet3  | East US  | 172.16.0.0/16    | Subnet3              |

The subnets have the IP address spaces shown in the following table.

| Name     | IP address space   |
|----------|--------------------|
| Subnet1  | 10.1.128.0/24      |
| Subnet21 | 192.168.0.0/17     |
| Subnet22 | 192.168.128.0/17   |
| Subnet3  | 172.16.1.0/24      |

You plan to create a container app named contapp1 in the East US Azure region.

You need to create a container app environment named con-env1 that meets the following requirements:

- Uses its own (and existing) virtual network.
- Uses its own (and new) subnet.
- Is connected to the smallest possible subnet.

To which virtual networks can you connect con-env1, and which subnet mask should you use? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

---

Answer Area  

Virtual network:  
VNet1 only  
VNet2 only  
VNet3 only  
VNet1 or VNet2 only  
VNet2 or VNet3 only  
VNet1 or VNet3 only  
VNet1, VNet2, or VNet3  

Subnet mask:  
/16  
/23  
/24  
/26  
/28

---

Box 1: VNet1, VNet2, or VNet3  
All three have large enough subnets, and Subnet Address Range Restrictions does not apply.  

Note 1: Custom VNet configuration  
As you create a custom VNet, keep in mind the following situations:  

If you want your container app to restrict all outside access, create an internal Container Apps environment.  

When you provide your own VNet, you need to provide a subnet that is dedicated to the Container App environment you deploy. This subnet isn't available to other services.  

Network addresses are assigned from a subnet range you define as the environment is created.  

You can define the subnet range used by the Container Apps environment.  
You can restrict inbound requests to the environment exclusively to the VNet by deploying the environment as internal.  

Note 2: Subnet Address Range Restrictions  
Subnet address ranges can't overlap with the following ranges reserved by AKS:  

169.254.0.0/16  
172.30.0.0/16  
172.31.0.0/16  
192.0.2.0/24  

Box 2: /26  
/26 is the smallest smaller than /27.  

Note: Environment Selection  
There are two environments in Container Apps: the Consumption only environment supports only the Consumption plan (GA) and the workload profiles environment that supports both the Consumption + Dedicated plan structure (preview).  
The two environments share many of the same networking characteristics. However, there are some key differences.  

* Workload profiles environment (preview) Supports user defined routes (UDR) and egress through NAT Gateway. The minimum required subnet size is /27.  

As workload profiles are currently in preview, the number of supported regions is limited.  

* Consumption only environment  
Doesn't support user defined routes (UDR) and egress through NAT Gateway. The minimum required subnet size is /23.  

Reference:  
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/container-apps/networking

scenarios.scenario: Configurar uma Subnet para Container Apps
scenarios.problem: Você precisa configurar um ambiente de Container Apps em uma VNet existente com a menor subnet possível.
scenarios.solution: Identifique a VNet apropriada (com espaço de endereço suficiente), crie uma subnet dedicada com máscara /26 e configure o ambiente para usá-la.
scenarios.explanation: A máscara /26 permite até 64 endereços IP, atendendo ao requisito de menor subnet possível, e a subnet dedicada evita conflitos de uso com outros serviços.

scenarios.problem: A subnet configurada entra em conflito com faixas de IP reservadas pelo AKS.
scenarios.solution: Verifique as faixas reservadas (como 172.30.0.0/16) e ajuste o intervalo de IPs da subnet para evitar sobreposição.
scenarios.explanation: As faixas reservadas não podem ser usadas, e ajustar o intervalo garante que o ambiente seja configurado corretamente.

scenarios.problem: Qual máscara de subnet usar para atender ao requisito de menor espaço possível para o ambiente?
scenarios.solution: Use a máscara /26, que fornece 64 endereços IP, conforme exigido pelos requisitos de Container Apps.
scenarios.explanation: A máscara /26 é a menor disponível para ambientes de Container Apps em um plano de consumo.

exercises.question: O que é uma VNet no Azure?
exercises.answer: Uma rede virtual que permite isolar e segmentar recursos em um ambiente controlado.
exercises.hint: Considere como redes são configuradas em nuvem.

exercises.question: Qual é a menor máscara de subnet que pode ser usada para um ambiente de Container Apps no modo de consumo?
exercises.hint: Considere o tamanho mínimo necessário para suportar os requisitos de endereçamento IP.

exercises.question: Como evitar conflitos de IP ao configurar subnets para Container Apps?
exercises.answer: Evite faixas reservadas, como 172.30.0.0/16, e ajuste o intervalo de IPs da subnet.
exercises.hint: Consulte as restrições de faixas reservadas.
exercises.topic: Restrições de Faixa de Endereços IP

exercises.question: Por que um ambiente de Container Apps não pode ser criado em uma subnet com máscara /28?
exercises.answer: A máscara /28 não atende ao requisito mínimo de endereçamento IP (mínimo /26 para consumo).
exercises.hint: Verifique o requisito de subnet para Container Apps.
exercises.topic: Ambientes de Container Apps no Azure

exercises.question: Qual comando pode ser usado para criar uma subnet no Azure CLI?
exercises.hint: Consulte os comandos relacionados a redes virtuais.

examTips.tip: Lembre-se das faixas de IP reservadas (ex.: 172.30.0.0/16) ao configurar subnets.

examTips.tip: Saiba diferenciar os tamanhos mínimos de subnet para ambientes de Container Apps (consumo vs. dedicado).
